title: Recon manifest — the attack surface the system discovered in the target
description: Emitted by the threat-model run. Every element carries grounding evidence (a path/glob/string that must resolve in the target) so the eval can check faithfulness without an answer key.

roles.description: distinct roles/principals the LLM identified (incl. anonymous/unauthenticated). Lets the RBAC-matrix precondition gate on a declared fact.

id.description: stable local id, e.g. C1 / D1 / E1 / TB1 / X1

evidence.description: repo-relative path, glob, or literal source string that proves this element exists in the target

kind.description: trust_boundary only: the boundary class the LLM assigned (lets the eval reason about multi-zone chains without inferring it)

manifest.description: external_dep only: path to the dependency manifest/lockfile in evidence (enables the SBOM precondition)

risk.description: external_dep only: free-text risk note the LLM set (e.g. EOL, known-CVE) — a declared fact, not eval-inferred
